harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired node1’s /srv/legacy2/minimal-environment-job/bin/render. It now resolves the helper and template relative to its installation directory, works from arbitrary working directories with only PATH=/usr/bin:/bin, and persists across reboot.
actions_performed: Diagnosed caller-relative template lookup and PATH-dependent helper lookup.
Updated render with installation-relative paths and argument validation while preserving root ownership and mode 0755.
Verified exact report output from / and /tmp, including paths containing spaces.
Confirmed the source template remained unchanged.
Restarted node1 exactly once and verified recovery with a changed boot ID.
Removed temporary test and rollback files; installed no packages and changed neither OS release nor kernel.

evidence.requirement: Render works with the required minimal environment from any working directory and retains report contents
evidence.summary: Direct tests with env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin succeeded from unrelated directories and produced BRANCH REPORT, Region: west, and Shipments: 17.

evidence.requirement: Render finds the supplied helper and template using installation-relative paths
evidence.summary: The installed script derives the application directory from its own path and invokes libexec/branch-format with templates/report.txt from that directory.
The template SHA-256 remained 60a2035d67e51a10515562d314f64c88029a1f2e78a15c24ae719ebdf1c28a03 before and after repair and restart.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel remain unchanged
evidence.summary: Node remains on RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64.

Healthy baseline was captured at boot ID 7223d5b7-fa56-4ff3-acee-959a5cf5f146; the native reboot was acknowledged; execution recovered at changed boot ID f8c1bca7-85ac-4dad-9222-2714637d0d8a; system state, files, template data, and minimal-environment rendering were healthy afterward.
